title: The Halberd Carrier's Primer
summary: A first primer teaching how to hold carry and swing a halberd with body strength alone to any untrained beginner.

title: First Drills of the Axe-Spear
summary: A short set of first drills for the axe blade and spear point meant for beginners who have only toughened their skin.

title: A Plain Treatise on Halberd Footwork
summary: A plain account of the paces and turns that carry a halberd fighter through a bout without using any qi.

title: Haft and Heel: A Beginner's Workbook
summary: A beginner's workbook pairing each grip on the haft with the heel placement that supports it in drill.

title: Five Lessons on the Long Axe Blade
summary: Five lessons on reach and edge control for students whose bones are hardened enough to swing a full halberd.

title: Handbook of the Spiked Pole
summary: A handbook for the plain pole with its spike and axe head covering stance poke hack shove guard and retreat.

title: The Breath and the Beak
summary: A first qi-aided text linking the circulating breath to hook and cleave so a new Senior can drive the halberd.

title: Shaft Discipline for Young Recruits
summary: A drill text that teaches recruits to keep the shaft level and the guard tight while a little qi supports the grip.

title: Notes on Halberd Guard and Return
summary: Notes on guarding high and low then answering at once with axe or spike for students who already circulate qi.

title: The Quickened Haft Workbook
summary: A workbook of fast snapping strikes and hurried sidesteps that qi lightens along the shaft for a new Senior.

title: Elementary Canon of Hook and Spike
summary: An elementary canon on the beak hook and the spike thrust used together by students who have begun circulating qi.

title: Reach and Rhythm: Halberd Basics
summary: Basics of measuring reach and keeping a steady rhythm of cut and thrust with the first circulation of qi.
